info.description: Audience folder `provider/` (provider token from the Auth collection: register with `app=provider`, D37). Slice 3 (+ follow-up 3a: coverage, event-location confirmation). Her own application only. Slice 5a (approved contract revision 3): calendar and availability blocks.

request.description: Her application and account state (draft, submitted, needs_completion with the reviewer's note, active, suspended with the reason). 200. Response `data` (ApplicationResource): `id, status, status_label, editable, status_reason` (suspended only), `completion {items[], note, requested_at}` (needs_completion only), `notes[{id, note, created_at}]` (notes to her; internal notes never sent), `account_type(_label), display_name, legal_name, representative_name, representative_title, email, phone, bio, city{id,name}, started_year, services[{id,name}], coverage[{id,name}], documents[{document_type{id,name,is_required}, document{id,status,status_label,rejection_reason,file{name,mime,size,url (signed, 10 min)},uploaded_at}|null}], photos[{id,url,caption}], submitted_at, activated_at`. Errors: 401 UNAUTHENTICATED · 403 FORBIDDEN (not a provider) / ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED · 404 NOT_FOUND · 409 INVALID_STATE (not editable / wrong state) · 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

Partial update; only sent fields change. Only in `draft`/`needs_completion` (else 409). Rules: account_type individual|establishment; display_name ≤60; legal_name ≤120, representative_name ≤60, representative_title ≤60 (cleared for individuals); email ≤120 (email); bio ≤400; city_id active city; started_year 1950–this year; service_ids[] active services (≤50); coverage_city_ids[] active cities (≤20). Empty strings → null. 200 + ApplicationResource. Errors: 401 UNAUTHENTICATED · 403 FORBIDDEN (not a provider) / ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED · 404 NOT_FOUND · 409 INVALID_STATE (not editable / wrong state) · 422 VALIDATION_FAILED.

item.name: Calendar & availability
item.description: Slice 5a (docs/slice-5a-contract.md, approved revision 3, D101). Calendar and delete: provider status active or suspended; create: active only (D96) — other statuses 409 INVALID_STATE; account suspended → 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED (unchanged). A confirmed deadlock is retried up to 3 times in fresh transactions, then 500 SERVER_ERROR (D98). Blocks are provider-wide, stored in UTC, half-open [starts_at, ends_at); Riyadh day D = [D-1 21:00Z, D 21:00Z). Only active (not soft-deleted) blocks count anywhere (D94). Create and delete are serialized with direct-request creation under a provider row lock (D90, D95). The provider app blocks whole days only (date form, D83).

request.description: from/to: Riyadh dates (YYYY-MM-DD), to >= from, at most 62 dates inclusive (to - from <= 61 days; 63 dates → 422 errors.to). from may be in the past. Returns her active blocks overlapping the range and her new/offer_sent requests (request awaiting_offers/offers_received) in the range, each with calendar_conflict. Not paginated. No working hours (D82). While she is suspended (provider status): her blocks, requests always [] (D96, D99; inbox stays closed).

request.description: Exactly one of: date (YYYY-MM-DD, today or later in Riyadh; Riyadh midnight to midnight) or starts_at + ends_at. reason optional (private, <= 255, empty → null). Allowed when requests fall on that day (D89): they are listed in conflicting_requests and not changed. Overlap with one of her ACTIVE blocks → 409 BLOCK_OVERLAP (D85); soft-deleted blocks never conflict, so a day can be re-blocked after unblocking (D94). No Idempotency-Key: a repeat of a successful call answers 409 BLOCK_OVERLAP (no second row) — reload the calendar. Not allowed while suspended (provider status) → 409 INVALID_STATE (D96).

request.description: starts_at/ends_at ISO-8601 (converted to UTC), whole minutes, ends_at > starts_at, ends_at > now (starts_at may be past), length <= 366 days (exactly 366 days OK, +1 minute → 422). Example = 13:00–17:00 Riyadh on 2026-12-06. A partial-day block does NOT put the date in the public unavailable_dates, but a direct request overlapping it gets 409 SLOT_UNAVAILABLE (D92). Two touching blocks (e.g. 00:00–12:00 and 12:00–24:00 Riyadh) are allowed and together make the date unavailable. Not used by the provider app (D83).

request.description: Soft delete (D94): the row is kept with deleted_at/deleted_by and an availability_unblocked history event; it no longer affects availability, calendar_conflict, the direct-request check or overlap validation. Her own active blocks only: another provider's, unknown or already deleted → 404 (a repeat of a successful delete answers 404 — reload the calendar). Runs under the provider row lock (D95). Requests are never changed. Also allowed while she is suspended at provider-status level (D96); other non-active statuses → 409 INVALID_STATE.

item.name: Wallet
item.description: Wallet CRUD (D106, docs/wallet-contract.md). Informational only (D106): the balance is derived from ledger entries, is never spendable, and no deposit, withdrawal, transfer, payment or refund endpoint exists. Own wallet only — there are no wallet ids in the URL.

request.description: 200. `data` is null when she has no active wallet (empty state), else the wallet. Example: {"id": 12, "owner_type": "provider", "label": "My wallet", "currency": "SAR", "status": "active", "status_label": "Active", "balance": {"amount": "0.00", "currency": "SAR", "is_spendable": false, "note": "For information only. This balance cannot be spent, withdrawn or used to pay for bookings."}, "created_at": "2026-11-15T09:00:00Z", "updated_at": "2026-11-15T09:00:00Z"}
201 with the wallet. Body: `label` optional, ≤ 60 chars. `balance`/`amount`/`currency` are prohibited (422). 409 WALLET_EXISTS when she already has an active wallet.
200 with the wallet. `label` is the only editable information; null clears it. 404 when she has no active wallet.
200, `data: null`. Closes the wallet (status `closed`, kept as history, never hard-deleted); she may create a new one afterwards. 404 when none; 409 INVALID_STATE when it has ledger entries.

item.name: Chat
item.description: Slice 7 (docs/slice-7-contract.md). Participants only; every other account gets 404. Status `active`/`read_only` is computed from the request lifecycle (§3). No realtime; poll or refresh.

request.description: Get-or-create on a request she received (her recipient row), 200. 404 when she is not a recipient; 409 INVALID_STATE when none exists yet and she no longer takes part.

Newest activity first. `filter[status]` active | read_only (archive). Example item: {"id": 7, "status": "active", "status_label": "Active", "can_send": true, "service_request": {"id": 12, "reference": "RN-1234567", "status": "offers_received", "status_label": "Offers received", "service": {"id": 3, "name": "Photography"}, "event_type": {"id": 1, "name": "Wedding"}, "event_date": "2026-12-05", "booking_id": null}, "provider": {"id": 4, "display_name": "Noura Lens", "avatar_url": null, "is_verified": true}, "last_message": {"id": 31, "type": "text", "body": "Is the date available?", "is_mine": true, "created_at": "2026-11-15T09:00:00Z"}, "last_message_at": "2026-11-15T09:00:00Z", "unread_count": 0, "created_at": "2026-11-15T08:59:00Z"}
One conversation (same shape as the list item); 404 for anyone but the two participants.

Newest first; `before` = older-than message id; `per_page` ≤ 50; `meta.has_more`, `meta.next_before`. Never marks anything read. Example: {"id": 31, "type": "text", "body": "Is the date available?", "client_uuid": "6f1c…", "is_mine": true, "sender_side": "client", "attachment": null, "offer": null, "read": false, "created_at": "2026-11-15T09:00:00Z"}
201 new / 200 same `client_uuid` + same payload; another payload with that uuid → 409 DUPLICATE_REQUEST. 409 INVALID_STATE when read-only.

Provider only: one of her offers on this request that the client can see. The card is rendered from the live offer (never copied).

Includes start_available_at and actions (can_start, can_complete, …).

item.description: Same Idempotency-Key + same amount → 200 replay; other amount → 409 DUPLICATE_REQUEST.

item.name: List team members
item.description: Her team, active first then by name. status=active|disabled optional; per_page max 50. Active provider only (409 INVALID_STATE otherwise).

item.name: Add team member
item.description: Records only, never a login (D230). title = role label, free text 1–60 (D236). phone optional Saudi mobile. photo_media_id optional: a shared/uploads file with context team_photo (private, D235). 201.

item.name: Update / disable / enable team member
item.description: Partial. phone / photo_media_id null clear them; status active|disabled. No delete route: nothing is deleted, assignments are kept (D233).

item.name: Set booking team
item.description: Replaces the booking's team with exactly these ids (may be empty, distinct, ≤ 50). Booking confirmed / in_progress only, else 409 INVALID_STATE (D232). A disabled member can stay but not be newly added (D233). Provider only; never shown to the client or dashboard (D230). 200 with the booking (team + actions.can_assign_team).
